findings.reason: without depends-on s8 the node cannot tell a §8 adapter refusal from the refusal it is diagnosing, and its repair may edit the same seam §8 guards.
findings.text: §11 declares no depends-on, but §8 (line 90) makes `complete_profile_current_adapter` raise whenever the build-time conductor vector differs from the resolution, and §11's seed current is read through exactly that adapter, so a §11 head run taken before §8 lands measures a different system and a §11 head run taken after §8 lands can refuse for §8's reason rather than the seed-current one

findings.reason: the passing branch's search would search the wrong interval, and one word ("head") fixes the bound the node diffs against.
findings.text: the candidate list is stated as "what changed between the receipt's producing revision and 37b9ba7c4", but the receipt's producing commit is 2026-08-23 (a60f18521) and the head is later than 37b9ba7c4 (2026-11-15), so if the benchmark passes at the head the distinguishing difference lies between 37b9ba7c4 and the head, an interval the enumeration excludes

response_events.note: §11 now waits on §8 in plan-section-depends-on, so its head run measures the adapter after the refusal lands
